title: Morning, the pup in the water
logline: One of the mornings: the pup, twelve, standing in a channel to his chest, still, the water gold around him, not going anywhere. The man's boots at the channel's edge. The page waits with both of them.

panels.composition: An old three-legged dog standing chest-deep in a gold tidal channel at morning, still, a man's boots at the channel's edge at the page's bottom.
